titre: Ubisoft Creates Generative AI Game Studio Called Motherbrain
chapo: Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in its games.
extrait: Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in games. Ubisoft’s latest earnings report, published on November 19, 2026, included a segment explaining its new operating model. Part of this model is a subsidiary called Motherbrain, which focuses on “AI for gameplay innovation” to “support all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences.” Further down in its report, Ubisoft reveals that the developers at Motherbrain are also the team behind its first playable, generative AI experience called Teammates. This new AI-focused studio will “develop proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators and open up new possibilities for richer, more immersive and engaging player experiences.” Ubisoft explains that Motherbrain is focused on creating “new player experiences, smart NPCs with memory, and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds.” Motherbrain was founded to “serve creators globally, both within Ubisoft’s Creative House ecosystem and beyond, and form partnerships with selected technology actors.” The existence of Teammates isn’t a surprise; Ubisoft revealed the project late last year, which some members of the media were able to play. It’s described as an immersive first-person shooter where players are accompanied by two robotic AI companions that they can order around using real-time voice commands. Speaking with VideoGamesChronicle, Teammates’ narrative director Virginie Mosser described AI as a “tool,” positing that it isn’t something that will ultimately replace entire swaths of the industry. “It’s a tool first. We’ve been working on it for more than two years now, and our conclusion is that it’s a super cool tool, but it’s still a tool,” she told the outlet. The reveal of this AI-focused studio, however, comes amid sweeping layoffs for those within the games industry. Just today, Ubisoft announced another round of layoffs, hemorrhaging 116 jobs across two of its major studios. And earlier this year, 40 jobs were cut at its Toronto studio, coinciding with a change in leadership with the exit of former creative director Clint Hocking. Currently, Ubisoft is hard at work on the next generation of Assassin’s Creed games, one of those being Project Hexe, a highly-anticipated installment in the series set during the European Witch Trials. chapo: Ubisoft confirms reports that it has a dedicated gen AI studio
extrait: Ubisoft confirms reports that it has a dedicated gen AI studio Ubisoft has founded a new subsidiary that is focused on generative AI in games. Ubisoft revealed this in its latest earnings report, confirming that its new studio, Motherbrain, will be dedicated to “AI for gameplay innovation”. Ubisoft mentions the founding of Motherbrain as part of its “new operating model”, which it began rolling out in January of this year, with the cancellation of six games.Â The move was described as a âmajor resetâ, which has seen Ubisoft split into different “creative houses”, focusing on different franchises based on their genre. As of this earnings report, Ubisoft says this new model is “fully in place” and outlines how Motherbrain will be part of that. “Motherbrain established as a dedicated subsidiary focused on AI for gameplay innovation, supporting all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences,” the report reads. Co-founder and CEO Yves Guillemot touches on Motherbrain’s work as part of his remarks in this earnings report, after praising the success of Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced. “We have also established Motherbrain, the team behind our first playable generative AI experience Teammates, as a dedicated subsidiary developing proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators and open up new possibilities for richer, more immersive and engaging player experiences,” Guillemot said. Teammates refers to Ubisoft’s experimental generative AI game, which was revealed in late 2025, and aims to allow players to speak with AI-powered NPC chatbots. This suggests that Ubisoft has not been dissuaded by public sentiment and will continue implementing generative AI into its games. Motherbrain’s existence leaked in September when Ubisoft trademarked the name. This was our first hint that Ubisoft was founding a studio dedicated to generative AI, as this purpose was mentioned in the trademark.Â Right now, it’s unclear if anything Motherbrain makes will be released as its own product, or if their work will feature in other Ubisoft games.
